name: Eleanor Vance
title: Principal DevOps Engineer
summary: Highly accomplished Principal DevOps Engineer with over a decade of experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining robust CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure. Proven expertise in driving automation, enhancing system reliability, and leading cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and resilient solutions.
skills: Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform
CI/CD: Jenkins, GitLab CI, ArgoCD, Spinnaker
Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation
Monitoring & Logging: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Datadog
Operating Systems: Linux (Ubuntu, RHEL), Windows Server
Networking: VPC, Load Balancers, DNS, VPN

bullets: Led a team of 5 DevOps engineers to design and implement a new Kubernetes-based platform on AWS, reducing infrastructure costs by 25% and improving deployment frequency by 40%.
Developed comprehensive CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI and ArgoCD, automating software releases and decreasing deployment time from hours to minutes for 15+ microservices.
Implemented robust monitoring and alerting solutions with Prometheus and Grafana, resulting in a 30% reduction in critical incident response times.
Mentored junior engineers and established best practices for Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and Python scripting, enhancing team efficiency and code quality.
Designed and managed scalable cloud infrastructure on Azure, supporting a critical e-commerce platform with over 1 million daily active users.
Automated environment provisioning and configuration management using Ansible, reducing setup time for new environments by 60%.
Implemented a centralized logging solution (ELK Stack) and established monitoring dashboards, improving system visibility and proactive issue detection.
Scripted various automation tasks in Python and Bash, streamlining operational workflows and reducing manual intervention by 20%.
Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins for multiple product teams, supporting continuous integration and delivery.
Managed Docker containers and helped transition applications to a containerized environment, improving application portability and resource utilization.
Collaborated with development teams to integrate automated testing into the CI pipeline, reducing defect escape rate by 15%.
